title: Ascension Event
subtitle: Test your grasp of the Ascension Event — the EMF flash, EBS revelations, Scare Events, 97% NPC removal, 3 Strings, Sky Event mechanics, and the restoration of true souls.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Ascension Event is the climax of the Great Spiritual Awakening: a 30-second EMF flash, preceded by EBS exposure and peak-fear Scare Events, that removes 97% NPC population, strips dampening overlays, and returns up to 178,000 years of memory to surviving true souls. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Ascension Event deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. Relinquishing Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge is not optional theory — it is the baseline that keeps the mind intact when the artificial fabric of reality collapses.

questions.question: What is the specific duration of the EMF (Electro Magnetic Frequency) burst that initiates the mass removal of the population?

options.label: A
options.text: 30 seconds
options.rationale: The Flash is characterized as a precise, 30-second burst of blinding white light that clears the planetary field.

options.label: B
options.text: 10 minutes, presented as if it were the natural or official account of events
options.rationale: This duration incorrectly suggests a prolonged event rather than the sudden, near-instantaneous burst described.

options.label: C
options.text: 12 hours — a cover story that cannot survive contact with the deeper mechanics
options.rationale: The energetic shift is much more rapid than a half-day cycle, designed for immediate structural dissolution.

options.label: D
options.text: 3 days, presented as if it were the natural or official account of events
options.rationale: While 'three days of darkness' is a common spiritual trope, it does not align with the rapid 30-second mechanic of the EMF.

questions.hint: Consider the timeframe of a sudden, blinding flash of light.
